link-text.$description: Link: the text and underline color of an inline or standalone link.

link-visited-text.$description: Link: the color of a visited inline link (:visited). The same role as an unvisited link until a visited role is chosen.

link-subtle-text.$description: Link: the subtle link, in the text color (footers, fine print).

link-on-accent-text.$description: Link: a link on the accent surface (the blue header).

link-font-weight.$description: Link: the weight of an inline link (the weight of the text around it).

link-standalone-font-weight.$description: Link: the weight of a standalone or back link, which stands on its own.

link-underline-width.$description: Link: the underline thickness at rest.

link-hover-underline-width.$description: Link: the underline thickness on hover.

link-radius.$description: Link: the corners of the focus ring around the text.

link-focus-outline-color.$description: Link: the focus ring color (keyboard focus).

link-focus-outline-offset.$description: Link: the gap between the text and the focus ring.

link-on-accent-focus-outline-color.$description: Link: the focus ring color on the accent surface.

link-standalone-gap.$description: Link: the gap between a standalone link’s text and its icon (back chevron, open icon).

link-standalone-min-height.$description: Link: a standalone or back link is at least the minimum target tall (24px with a pointer, 44px with touch).

link-icon-size.$description: Link: the size of the back chevron and the open icon.

link-icon-gap.$description: Link: the space before the open icon of an inline external link.
